subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should `operator.questions`, the five `question.*` RPCs, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` become the supported provider-neutral question contract in this release?
rationale: The branch is technically plausible and well demonstrated, but it creates a permanent Gateway and external Plugin SDK surface whose ownership and compatibility policy cannot be inferred safely from tests or the contributor proposal alone.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
options.body: Confirm the current Gateway record and resolver as the supported contract after exact-head verification of the prior routing findings and required checks.

options.title: Keep the resolver internal
options.body: Retain the provider-neutral runtime but replace the public SDK subpath with a bundled-channel-only facade until external plugin requirements are established.

options.title: Defer provider-neutral questions
options.body: Pause this PR and keep only the already-merged Codex-native question path while the broader protocol is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the current Gateway record and resolver as the supported contract after exact-head verification of the prior routing findings and required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this branch make this person the clearest available owner of the question-runtime direction.
